float64_cpu: asserted for both arms before their first frame (scripts/39 Arm)

input_files.note: sha256 at the start of the run; the git status of every input inside the repository is in 'git'. The archived QE outputs are not hashed: they are tied to the hashed dataset by the scripts/44 cross-check (check 4)

status: post hoc, reported only; a pre-specified description, no verdict

definitions.paths: P = 0 -> 1 -> 2 [-> 3] to i*; C = chord 0 -> 2 [-> 3] to i*; n = 8 points per segment (r_k + j/8 dr_k), n = 4 and 2 subsets, n = 1 the images; extension 2 -> 3 for i* = 2 bands (beside)
definitions.work: W = -sum 1/2 (F_a + F_b) . (r_b - r_a), per atom before summation, meV; closure = W - [E(end) - E(start)]
definitions.work_quantity: n8, n4, n2, n1; e = |X8 - X4|/3; richardson = X8 + (X8 - X4)/3; abs_8_minus_4 (the conservative error of statements); ratio_2_4_over_4_8 = (X2 - X4)/(X4 - X8)
definitions.dS: [E_FT(i*) - E_FT(0)] - [E_ZS(i*) - E_ZS(0)] (the segment change, scripts/44 segment_change_meV)
definitions.kappa: (|L| + |N|)/|L + N|, L = dW(hop_I) + dW(inorganic_near), N = the other three (Richardson)
definitions.d_eps_g: site-energy gauge, calculator property 'energies' (keeps the E0s; they cancel)
definitions.hermite: cubic Hermite with E at both images and dE/dlambda = -F . dr_k; excess = max_j E(lambda_j) - H(lambda_j); D3d.hermite = the segments of P to i* only; D3d.hermite_chord_0_2_beside = the chord 0-2 (beside, not D3d); extension_2_3.D3d_hermite_2_3 = the extension's 2-3 segment (i* = 2 bands)
definitions.extension_2_3: i* = 2 bands only: P_ext and C_ext to image 3, beside, outside every criterion, D3d block and summary; criteria_values_no_status = the numbers criteria 1-2 would use, with no status or pass/fail flag
definitions.resolved: plan section 6 criteria 1-2 on P (status), on C (status_C)

interpretations_of_plan: path points: interior point j of segment k is r_k + (j/8) dr_k with dr_k = find_mic(r_k+1 - r_k) in the band cell; j = 0 and j = 8 are the stored images; the quadrature step of a segment at n intervals is dr_k/n (the plan's 'n equal steps of dr_k/n'), not the difference of rounded point positions

check 3 'minimum-image displacement equals the raw displacement' and 'r_start + dr = r_end' are tested per Cartesian component within 1e-8 A (the plan's tolerance of the second); 'same cell' within 1e-12 A, species identical
check 4 is the scripts/44 Data.need cross-check of images 0, 2, 3, 4 and 6 (the plan's parenthesis); it also compares the dataset's DFT energies and forces with the archived QE outputs
check 5 covers images 0-4 (image 1 is not in the dataset; it is read from the band file); per-atom energies are compared with the band file's per-atom 'energies' array

check 6 tolerance 1e-3 meV for every reproduced number (the plan states it for segments_beside); groups_meV, segment_change_meV and direct_meV are recomputed with scripts/44 path_work and attribution from the new image single points; i* from the dataset REF_energy_raw by scripts/44 argmax; D2a i_star is compared for dft, zeroshot and finetuned
statements and summaries use the Richardson value X_R of every work quantity; the ratio dW_g/W_ZS,g, its 5 meV threshold (|W_ZS,g,R| >= 5 meV) and kappa use Richardson values

a convergence ratio is null where its denominator is exactly zero; such a case falls under the criterion's exemption (|closure8| < 0.5 meV, |dW_g,4 - dW_g,8| < 0.3 meV); bounds are inclusive ([2, 8], <= 2 meV, <= 3 meV)
D_g is summed over the n = 8 steps of P (each segment's steps are equal, so every n gives the same share)

section 7 item 4 'the mean and the largest |dW_g(P) - dW_g(C)|': the mean of |d| and the largest |d| (Richardson); the signed mean is given beside; 'the mean of e(P) + e(C)' with e = |X8 - X4|/3 as defined, and beside it the mean of |X8 - X4|(P) + |X8 - X4|(C) (the conservative error of statements)

section 7 item 5 is summarised over the P-resolved bands (C's own status not required; the number whose C fails is given); 'the median and the largest absolute value' = the median of the signed difference and the largest |.|
section 7 item 7 is given per model (zero-shot, fine-tuned) for P and C, over the P-resolved bands

'by host ... the mean of the host means': every statistic named mean* of the per-host summaries is averaged over the hosts with at least one resolved band (equal host weights); medians, ranges and counts are given per host only

sign comparison: SE = sample SD (ddof 1)/sqrt(n) of the per-band values of the subset; work margin = max(2 meV, 2 SE) + mean |dW_g,8 - dW_g,4|, site-energy margin = max(2 meV, 2 SE); 'exceed' is strict; with n < 2 the SE is undefined and the sign is 'not resolved'; given for every summary subset (overall, split, host); per band, a group's signs agree when sign(dW_g,R) = sign(d_eps_g)
6 A crossings: an atom counts if at any point of P from image 0 to i* (images and interior points) its minimum-image distance to the fixed hop midpoint is on the other side of 6 A than at image 0

shortest intramolecular bond = the shortest minimum-image distance between two atoms of the same image-0 molecule; reported per segment (minimum over its interior points) against the minimum over the path's images 0..i*
Hermite excess and the excess above the higher bracketing image are in meV, over the 7 interior points j = 1..7
splits: training = D2 'train', m21 = D2 'valid', test = D2 'test'; hosts are the 14 mNN of the 37 bands

the extension 2 -> 3 of the two i* = 2 bands (extension_2_3) carries the D3a/D3b quantities of P_ext and C_ext, the numbers to which criteria 1-2 would apply (criteria_values_no_status: closure8, closure4/closure8, |dW8 - dW4|, e and the convergence ratio; no status, no 'meets' or 'failed' and no per-criterion pass/fail flag), d_eps_g and dS to image 3 (D3c_to_image3) and the Hermite excess of its 2-3 segment (D3d_hermite_2_3); it enters no criterion, no D3d block and no summary
additions_to_plan: development option --bands-only (a subset; refused for the default --out-dir; JSON marked development_subset); the recorded run uses all 37 bands
order: no interpolated point is evaluated before checks 1-6 and 8 have passed on the images and geometries
check 6 also reproduces D2a i_star of the two models, D2b segment_change_meV and direct_meV, and the group sizes; the new n = 1 quadrature on C is asserted to equal scripts/44 path_work (1e-9 meV)
i* in {2, 3} and the i* = 2 bands = {m21_GA, m21_Sr} (plan section 1) are asserted (exit 6)
the plan's last commit is asserted to be ddb352b, the commit this script implements (exit 4)
'energies' assertion at every single point: energies - node_energy = the model's per-element E0 (1e-9 eV)
n = 1 values (images only) are recorded beside n = 8, 4, 2 for every work quantity (P at n = 1 gives check 10; C at n = 1 is the coarse D2b)

Hermite excess also for the chord 0-2 (D3d.hermite_chord_0_2_beside, beside D3d, not part of it) and for the 2-3 segment of the extension (extension_2_3.D3d_hermite_2_3); D3d.hermite holds the segments of P to i* only; D_g also along C; d_eps_g and dS to image 3 for the two extension bands
molecule check also at the extension points; reported beside it at image 4
the E_a link identity is asserted (1e-9 meV)

the console log is appended to d3_console.log only after a run with exit 0; a failed run writes nothing to --out-dir (neither the JSON nor the console log), so the repository log holds only completed runs (section 9)
summaries also give dS, the summed dW and SE beside the plan's statistics
